title: Why Peaks Beat Scrubbing VODs
description: Platform signal beats manual VOD scrubbing for Short production.
author: AuraFlux
body_html:
Manual clip hunting scales with hours watched. Peaks scales with platform signal: heat maps, chat density, and live CCV already tell you where the energy was.

AuraFlux wraps that signal with edits (compose presets, captions, brand, QA) and publish — so the product is Peaks plus production, not a single-feature clip tool.
